seen.body:
## Where

docs/user/

## Goal

User guide and FAQ in plain words for singers and voice trainees: no code, no IDs, describes only built behaviour, built and checked on every change but published only at the first public release

## Done when

Skeleton and first FAQ entries (is it free, does my voice leave my phone, what does confidence mean) build and pass the checks
seen.title: Start the user guide and FAQ, unpublished until release
